text_block_list.text: One day in February...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Chatter, chatter...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
My! It's quite crowded. And the tables
aren't even
set yet.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Buono! Is everyone here? This is more
than I
expected!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text:
But the more, the merrier! All right,
everyone! To
the kitchen!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Hmm?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: (Why am I making chocolate?!)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
(I somehow got swept up in the crowd,
but I guess
someone will let me know if
I'm not supposed to
be here...)
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Your tempering technique is
amazing! And
your attention to detail is
bona fide buono!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Акэбоно

text_block_list.text: Um... Thank you...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Aaah!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Crash!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, my! Are you all right?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: I-I think so...
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness. Was it only the one
bowl that
you dropped? That's not so
bad. There's no need
to panic—we'll get
this taken care of in no time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Why did I stay the whole time?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I have training in five minutes! What am I
going to
do with all this?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I already bought chocolates for Trainer.
If I were
to give something homemade as
well, it might
give the wrong
impression...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'm overthinking this. It's totally fine to
give both
store-bought and homemade
chocolate. And I
can always explain
myself, if necessary.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer! I'm ready to get to work.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you certainly seem ready to go.
But before
that, I wanted to thank you
for everything—
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Huh? O-oh, no! It's nothing! There's
absolutely
nothing wrong at all!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I-it's just, today is Valentine's Day,
right? So, I
thought I might g-give you
some chocolates!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So, happy Valentine's Day! Thank you
for all of
your expert instruction!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Now, let's get to work, shall we? I'll start
warming
up!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Ah, uhhh... Ummm... Let me start first by
saying...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day. It's a day in
which
people have traditionally
expressed affection.
However, it has also
become a day in which to
express
gratitude and friendship.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, the act of offering chocolates
to those
we feel indebted to should not
be considered
unusual in any way or
have any presumed subtext
associated
with it!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Phew...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
So, I got some chocolates for you. I
bought them
at the store the other day.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But wait, there's more! I also have these
for you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: They're... I, uh, made them myself.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
O-of course! I think they accurately
convey my
feelings of gratitude.
Although, truthfully, even
two may be
inadequate for that...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I wasn't planning on making homemade

chocolates, but I think they turned out
fairly well.
I hope you like them.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
If you find yourself preferring the ones
that I
made, I'll bear that in mind and
focus more of my
efforts to that end
next time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Despite her strange behavior, the
chocolates she
gives me are simply
delicious.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Although both are good, the homemade
ones
seem to taste just a bit sweeter.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
